objective: Qualify a mainstream, sufficiently large RESIDE OTS source-scene pool for an independent synthetic-outdoor measurement design without importing the failed indoor q gate or contaminating Haze4K and SOTS-outdoor comparisons.

ots_overlap_resolution.core_assumption: The remaining 42 provenance-expected Haze4K outdoor sources can be uniquely mapped to OTS by a matcher that first recovers every already verified OTS source.
ots_overlap_resolution.close_condition: Close if the frozen robust retrieval method cannot reproduce the verified mappings or uniquely resolve all 42 remaining sources.

ots_full_retrieval.core_assumption: Searching all 542 strict-unmatched Haze4K source groups against OTS can identify exactly the 42 provenance-expected outdoor sources under frozen positive-control, negative-control, uniqueness, mutual-nearest, and capacity gates.
ots_full_retrieval.close_condition: Close if the frozen full-query retrieval cannot recover its known OTS controls, admits any negative control, or cannot uniquely identify exactly 42 additional OTS sources.

synthetic_outdoor_measurement.core_assumption: A disjoint OTS clear-scene pool with paired depth and haze variants can support a separately defined synthetic-outdoor local measurement.
synthetic_outdoor_measurement.close_condition: Close if an independently specified outdoor measurement lacks coverage, precision, or negative-control separation under scene-level analysis.
